paragraphs.text: Finally then, brethren, we beseech and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that, as ye received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God, even as ye do walk, --that ye abound more and more.
paragraphs.original: Λοιπὸν οὖν, ἀδελφοί, ἐρωτῶμεν ὑμᾶς καὶ παρακαλοῦμεν ἐν κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ, ἵνα καθὼς παρελάβετε παρʼ ἡμῶν τὸ πῶς δεῖ ὑμᾶς περιπατεῖν καὶ ἀρέσκειν θεῷ, καθὼς καὶ περιπατεῖτε, ἵνα περισσεύητε μᾶλλον.
paragraphs.translit: Loipon oun, adelphoi, erōtōmen hymas kai parakaloumen en kyriō Iēsou, hina kathōs parelabete parʼ hēmōn to pōs dei hymas peripatein kai areskein theō, kathōs kai peripateite, hina perisseuēte mallon.

paragraphs.text: For ye know what charge we gave you through the Lord Jesus.
paragraphs.original: οἴδατε γὰρ τίνας παραγγελίας ἐδώκαμεν ὑμῖν διὰ τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: oidate gar tinas parangelias edōkamen hymin dia tou kyriou Iēsou.

paragraphs.text: For this is the will of God, [even] your sanctification, that ye abstain from fornication;
paragraphs.original: τοῦτο γάρ ἐστιν θέλημα τοῦ θεοῦ, ὁ ἁγιασμὸς ὑμῶν, ἀπέχεσθαι ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ τῆς πορνείας,
paragraphs.translit: touto gar estin thelēma tou theou, ho hagiasmos hymōn, apechesthai hymas apo tēs porneias,

paragraphs.text: that each one of you know how to possess himself of his own vessel in sanctification and honor,
paragraphs.original: εἰδέναι ἕκαστον ὑμῶν τὸ ἑαυτοῦ σκεῦος κτᾶσθαι ἐν ἁγιασμῷ καὶ τιμῇ,
paragraphs.translit: eidenai hekaston hymōn to heautou skeuos ktasthai en hagiasmō kai timē,

paragraphs.text: not in the passion of lust, even as the Gentiles who know not God;
paragraphs.original: μὴ ἐν πάθει ἐπιθυμίας καθάπερ καὶ τὰ ἔθνη τὰ μὴ εἰδότα τὸν θεόν,
paragraphs.translit: mē en pathei epithymias kathaper kai ta ethnē ta mē eidota ton theon,

paragraphs.text: that no man transgress, and wrong his brother in the matter: because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, as also we forewarned you and testified.
paragraphs.original: τὸ μὴ ὑπερβαίνειν καὶ πλεονεκτεῖν ἐν τῷ πράγματι τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ, διότι ἔκδικος κύριος περὶ πάντων τούτων, καθὼς καὶ προείπαμεν ὑμῖν καὶ διεμαρτυράμεθα.
paragraphs.translit: to mē hyperbainein kai pleonektein en tō pragmati ton adelphon autou, dioti ekdikos kyrios peri pantōn toutōn, kathōs kai proeipamen hymin kai diemartyrametha.

paragraphs.text: For God called us not for uncleanness, but in sanctification.
paragraphs.original: οὐ γὰρ ἐκάλεσεν ἡμᾶς ὁ θεὸς ἐπὶ ἀκαθαρσίᾳ ἀλλʼ ἐν ἁγιασμῷ.
paragraphs.translit: ou gar ekalesen hēmas ho theos epi akatharsia allʼ en hagiasmō.

paragraphs.text: Therefore he that rejecteth, rejecteth not man, but God, who giveth his Holy Spirit unto you.
paragraphs.original: τοιγαροῦν ὁ ἀθετῶν οὐκ ἄνθρωπον ἀθετεῖ ἀλλὰ τὸν θεὸν τὸν καὶ διδόντα τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτοῦ τὸ ἅγιον εἰς ὑμᾶς.
paragraphs.translit: toigaroun ho athetōn ouk anthrōpon athetei alla ton theon ton kai didonta to pneuma autou to hagion eis hymas.

paragraphs.text: But concerning love of the brethren ye have no need that one write unto you: for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another;
paragraphs.original: Περὶ δὲ τῆς φιλαδελφίας οὐ χρείαν ἔχετε γράφειν ὑμῖν, αὐτοὶ γὰρ ὑμεῖς θεοδίδακτοί ἐστε εἰς τὸ ἀγαπᾶν ἀλλήλους·
paragraphs.translit: Peri de tēs philadelphias ou chreian echete graphein hymin, autoi gar hymeis theodidaktoi este eis to agapan allēlous·

paragraphs.text: for indeed ye do it toward all the brethren that are in all Macedonia. But we exhort you, brethren, that ye abound more and more;
paragraphs.original: καὶ γὰρ ποιεῖτε αὐτὸ εἰς πάντας τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς τοὺς ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ Μακεδονίᾳ. παρακαλοῦμεν δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, περισσεύειν μᾶλλον,
paragraphs.translit: kai gar poieite auto eis pantas tous adelphous tous en holē tē Makedonia. parakaloumen de hymas, adelphoi, perisseuein mallon,

paragraphs.text: and that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your hands, even as we charged you;
paragraphs.original: καὶ φιλοτιμεῖσθαι ἡσυχάζειν καὶ πράσσειν τὰ ἴδια καὶ ἐργάζεσθαι ταῖς χερσὶν ὑμῶν, καθὼς ὑμῖν παρηγγείλαμεν,
paragraphs.translit: kai philotimeisthai hēsychazein kai prassein ta idia kai ergazesthai tais chersin hymōn, kathōs hymin parēngeilamen,

paragraphs.text: that ye may walk becomingly toward them that are without, and may have need of nothing.
paragraphs.original: ἵνα περιπατῆτε εὐσχημόνως πρὸς τοὺς ἔξω καὶ μηδενὸς χρείαν ἔχητε.
paragraphs.translit: hina peripatēte euschēmonōs pros tous exō kai mēdenos chreian echēte.

paragraphs.text: But we would not have you ignorant, brethren, concerning them that fall asleep; that ye sorrow not, even as the rest, who have no hope.
paragraphs.original: Οὐ θέλομεν δὲ ὑμᾶς ἀγνοεῖν, ἀδελφοί, περὶ τῶν κοιμωμένων, ἵνα μὴ λυπῆσθε καθὼς καὶ οἱ λοιποὶ οἱ μὴ ἔχοντες ἐλπίδα.
paragraphs.translit: Ou thelomen de hymas agnoein, adelphoi, peri tōn koimōmenōn, hina mē lypēsthe kathōs kai hoi loipoi hoi mē echontes elpida.

paragraphs.text: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also that are fallen asleep in Jesus will God bring with him.
paragraphs.original: εἰ γὰρ πιστεύομεν ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἀπέθανεν καὶ ἀνέστη, οὕτως καὶ ὁ θεὸς τοὺς κοιμηθέντας διὰ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἄξει σὺν αὐτῷ.
paragraphs.translit: ei gar pisteuomen hoti Iēsous apethanen kai anestē, houtōs kai ho theos tous koimēthentas dia tou Iēsou axei syn autō.

paragraphs.text: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we that are alive, that are left unto the coming of the Lord, shall in no wise precede them that are fallen asleep.
paragraphs.original: τοῦτο γὰρ ὑμῖν λέγομεν ἐν λόγῳ κυρίου, ὅτι ἡμεῖς οἱ ζῶντες οἱ περιλειπόμενοι εἰς τὴν παρουσίαν τοῦ κυρίου οὐ μὴ φθάσωμεν τοὺς κοιμηθέντας·
paragraphs.translit: touto gar hymin legomen en logō kyriou, hoti hēmeis hoi zōntes hoi perileipomenoi eis tēn parousian tou kyriou ou mē phthasōmen tous koimēthentas·

paragraphs.text: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven, with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first;
paragraphs.original: ὅτι αὐτὸς ὁ κύριος ἐν κελεύσματι, ἐν φωνῇ ἀρχαγγέλου καὶ ἐν σάλπιγγι θεοῦ, καταβήσεται ἀπʼ οὐρανοῦ, καὶ οἱ νεκροὶ ἐν Χριστῷ ἀναστήσονται πρῶτον,
paragraphs.translit: hoti autos ho kyrios en keleusmati, en phōnē archangelou kai en salpingi theou, katabēsetai apʼ ouranou, kai hoi nekroi en Christō anastēsontai prōton,

paragraphs.text: then we that are alive, that are left, shall together with them be caught up in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.
paragraphs.original: ἔπειτα ἡμεῖς οἱ ζῶντες οἱ περιλειπόμενοι ἅμα σὺν αὐτοῖς ἁρπαγησόμεθα ἐν νεφέλαις εἰς ἀπάντησιν τοῦ κυρίου εἰς ἀέρα· καὶ οὕτως πάντοτε σὺν κυρίῳ ἐσόμεθα.
paragraphs.translit: epeita hēmeis hoi zōntes hoi perileipomenoi hama syn autois harpagēsometha en nephelais eis apantēsin tou kyriou eis aera· kai houtōs pantote syn kyriō esometha.

paragraphs.text: Wherefore comfort one another with these words.
paragraphs.original: ὥστε παρακαλεῖτε ἀλλήλους ἐν τοῖς λόγοις τούτοις.
paragraphs.translit: hōste parakaleite allēlous en tois logois toutois.
